title: ForenRAG: An Event-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Provenance-Oriented Post-Alert Digital Forensic Investigation
description:
ForenRAG is a research prototype for automated post-alert digital forensic investigation in a controlled Windows laboratory. It correlates high-severity Wazuh alerts with Sysmon telemetry in OpenSearch, creates structured evidence packages, retrieves technique-relevant knowledge from ChromaDB, and uses a local Ollama model to generate forensic reports.

Version 0.1.2 adds the sanitised 30-row matched RAG/no-RAG ablation dataset and updates the accompanying dataset documentation. The release retains the trial-level timing, collector-validation, retrieval, reference-review phase, report-grounding, major-error-category, reproducibility, and knowledge-source provenance materials introduced in version 0.1.1.

Original ForenRAG source code is licensed under Apache-2.0. Sanitised data under study_dataset/ are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Bundled third-party knowledge sources retain the separate licences and terms documented in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
